cohort: The study included 1271 infants admitted to the NICU at Tufts Medical Center (TMC) between 2012 and 2015.
finding: The study found a significant association between hypothermia at NICU admission and maternal race, birth weight, gestational age, antenatal steroids, chorioamnionitis, mode of delivery, and Apgar scores.
mod_finding: There was a significant association found between hypothermia at NICU admission and mode of delivery.
